title: Circulation
description: The heart pushes blood through vessels that branch finer and finer; the flow in each follows the fourth power of its radius. Unlocks Perfused Tissue.

puzzle.goal: Flow through a vessel goes as the fourth power of its radius (Poiseuille). A vessel of radius r carries a base flow; write the flow Q for radius r, from a constant c.
puzzle.name: Fourth-power flow
puzzle.ask: Find Q for c = @{c} and r = 3.
puzzle.method: Poiseuille: Q = pi.r^4.dP / 8.eta.L, so a small change in radius is a large change in flow.
